items.q: Charlie James, he was associated with the union down there at one time in Philadelphia, the negro union.

ctx.x: Charlie James, he was associated with the union down there at one time in Philadelphia, the negro union. Yeah, that's another one, see how it comes to me, I can't, see - because I didn't work that long. You see, that's where, that's where you can get me mixed -
There were two unions in Philadelphia?
